Hi Jason,

Thank you for that, and sorry for asking when you had already sent it. You're right, the tracking you sent shows it delivered at 1:12 pm on October 13, and that address is our Chattanooga warehouse, so the parcel is with us.

What happened on our side is that it went back under the earlier label rather than the one we re-sent on October 16, so it hasn't been matched to your RMA yet and still shows as awaiting arrival. That's ours to sort, not yours. I've put your tracking number and the delivery scan in front of the warehouse team today so they can receive it against Shop····.

Nothing more is needed from you, and your replacement DC02 is yours to keep either way. I'll come back to you in this thread as soon as it's checked in.

Sorry again for the extra chasing.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
